name: Humvee (M1114-style)
identity: Supplied low-poly-humvee-vehicle.zip (Humvee.fbx + 1K_MilitaryVehicle_TXTR.png, no author or licence in the archive): scaled x1.36 to 4.6 m; the painted-on windows are opened up and the cab furnished by tools/vehicles/convert_vehicles.py humvee (dash with gauges and switch panel, radio stack, drive tunnel with levers, steering wheel, pedals, four bucket seats, grab bar, armrests). The baked model is local-only (git-ignored, licence unknown); without it the committed part-built fallback (models/humvee_fallback) is drawn.

model.note: converted by tools/vehicles/convert_vehicles.py humvee into assets_src/vehicles/humvee.glb first

fallbackModel.note: part-built stand-in made of boxes and cylinders by tools/vehicles/make_fallback.py humvee (committed)

rig.note: driver's eye = steering wheel centre + driverEyeFromSteer (left-hand drive, eye ~1.55 m under the 1.77 m roof); exits by the four doors, behind, ahead

colliders.note: one body box in hull space from the baked hull bounds (antenna left out)

carDrive.note: steerRate: lock fractions per second (the input is smoothed); steerTurns: steering-wheel turns lock to lock; runOverDamage: soldier damage per m/s of impact speed

mobility.note: gameplay profile: 70 km/h on roads, 53 km/h off-road

dash.note: VH6b src/vehicle_dash.cpp: the interior content/vehicles/dash/humvee.json, anchored at the driver's eye + offset
